aliasPolicy.priority: first nonblank in existing Server priority content,text,reasoning; if only whitespace exists, preserve the first nonempty whitespace fragment

moduleExtraction.interfaces: explicit stored provider, prepared request, route, execution deadline, timing, usage and request-memory owners; returns Value plus the original reservation
